mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO payment_event (event_id, event_type, payment_order_no, user_id, activity_id, sku_id, payload_hash, status) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{paymentOrderNo}, #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{skuId}, #{payloadHash}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_event SET status = #{status}, purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId}, removed_unused_count = #{removedUnusedCount}, consumed_exposure_count = #{consumedExposureCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 0
